clusters.label: Similaridade Léxica
clusters.rationale: Broad definition of lexical similarity stands alone; no other candidate covers just the definition without specific metrics or applications, keeping it a distinct teachable concept.

clusters.label: Distância de Edição Mínima e Levenshtein
clusters.rationale: Specific metric (edit distance) with Levenshtein variant; separate from other metrics because each metric has its own calculation and testable question.

clusters.label: Similaridade de Jaccard
clusters.rationale: Jaccard similarity is a distinct metric based on set intersection over union, not interchangeable with other measures.

clusters.label: Similaridade de Cosseno
clusters.rationale: Cosine similarity using vector angles is a separate concept with its own implementation and interpretation, distinct from character-based and other term-based metrics.

clusters.label: Classificação de Algoritmos de Similaridade de Strings
clusters.rationale: Classification of algorithms into character-based and term-based is a meta-concept, not a specific metric, and requires different learning outcomes.

clusters.label: Aplicações de Similaridade Textual
clusters.rationale: Applications of text similarity form a separate topic from the metrics themselves, focusing on use cases rather than computation.
